newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Trygg-Hansa says to cut costs in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Trygg-Hansa says to cut costs in 1997.

text.p: Swedish insurer Trygg-Hansa said on Tuesday it was to increase efficiency through further cost cuts in 1997, aiming to trim 150-220 million crowns off costs in the staff and services division.
"In the spring we will carry out among other things a special survey throughout the company's staff and services division," the company's managing director Lars Thunell said in the annual report.
"The aim is to reduce costs by 150-200 million crowns to the middle of 1998."
The company said these savings would come on top of savings following a rationalisation programme in its distribution, non-life, underwriting and new technology.
